script.name: recheck_md.py
script.what: second, independent implementation of the specification

units: distances in Angstrom, angles in degrees, times in ns, frame intervals in ps

asn67_ND2.note: reported only; the states use OD1

water_ring_place.note: site atoms P and cut-off c of n_water_ring_place and d_water_ring_place_min_A (section 9D); the wider count always uses C1 to C6 and N1 and 3.5 A

start_of_production.note: solute frame 0 of the production against the start as built

equilibration.note: equilibration frames: a series of their own, times zero or negative; they enter no statistic of the production

gate_GV.note: gate G-V of md/PLAN.md; a verdict only for the validation run X0

reported_zn_glu106.note: reported beside the gate, no criterion (sections 9C and 11)
